text:
morgan: Heads up — canary rollout (5.2.1) showing a 15–25% p99 token latency regression after merging PR #3421 (queue-thresholds). Noticed around 12:15 UTC.

alex: saw it too. Query routing shows more kernel switches per request for seqlen ~512-1024.

rita: ran a quick profile on a canary node, looks like our kernel selector is oscillating because the new queue thresholds push more batches to the mid-size path -> extra KV cache evictions. snippet:

```
Profiler: kernel_switch_count: 1.8x baseline
KV_evictions/sec: 2.1x baseline
Most swaps at seqlen bucket 512-1024
```

sam: CI perf job failed on the merge commit: https://ci.redwood/rep/infra/latency/4567 — benchmark says median ok but tail up.

morgan: rolling this back from canary now. @ci-bot can you stop the canary rollout?

ci-bot: stopped rollout for canary group "us-west-1-canary". Reason: manual stop requested by morgan.

lee: thanks. We need a coordinated hotfix: either revert the threshold change or cherry-pick a kernel selector guard. Which is faster?

rita: revert is simplest but will reintroduce previous batching inefficiency. I have a smaller change that clamps threshold crossing for mid-size batches to avoid immediate kernel switch. Can prepare a cherry-pick (commit abcdef123).

alex: can we run the candidate cherry-pick against the perf harness? I can queue a job if Rita posts the commit.

rita: pushing branch rita/evict-clamp now -> PR #3499 (cherry-pick of abcdef123 onto release-5.2). It adds a 50ms hysteresis around threshold boundaries and avoids evicting KV cache when batch count is below 3.

sam: queued perf run: https://ci.redwood/rep/infra/latency/4599 (running). If this passes, we can backport to release branch and promote.

lee: action items: 1) Hold wider rollout (done). 2) Verify PR #3499 perf results. 3) If green, cherry-pick to release-5.2 and cut hotfix 5.2.2. 4) If not green, revert PR #3421 from main and backport revert to release branch.

morgan: tagging oncall to monitor: @sam please hold any other kernel heuristics merges until we have a green hotfix. Also add an eval that exercises seqlen 512/1024 to catch regressions. :eyes:

sam: will hold merges and add the eval set now. Perf job is at 18% complete — I’ll post results.

rita: thanks. I’ll also add a short unit test for the hysteresis and KV-eviction guard.

alex: once CI job completes, ping here and we’ll coordinate cherry-pick and a quick canary smoke.

morgan: appreciate the quick turnaround everyone.

(THREAD END)
